messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | **A** | preposition (dative) “to” | *UNNECESSARY* (no separate word) | – | UNNECESSARY | | **te** | 2nd‑sg. pronoun (accusative) “you” | உனக்கு | “to you” | OK | | **convien** | modal “it behoves / must” | வேண்டும் | “must / is obligatory” | OK | | **tenere** | infinitive “to hold / undertake” | எடுத்துக் கொள்ள | “to take‑hold / undertake” | OK | | **altro** | adjective “another” | மற்றொரு | “another” | OK | | **vïaggio** | noun “journey / course” | பயணத்தை | “the journey (ACC)” | OK | | **rispuose** | verb “replied” | பதிலளித்தார் | “replied” | OK | | **poi** | adverb “after / when” (temporal) | கண்டபோது | “when (saw)” | OK | | **che** | conjunction “that / when” | *UNNECESSARY* (absorbed in “கண்டபோது”) | – | UNNECESSARY | | **lagrimar** | infinitive “to weep” | அழுததை | “the weeping” | OK | | **mi** | pronoun “me” (acc.) | என்னை | “me” | OK | | **vide** | verb “saw” | கண்ட | “saw” | OK | | **se** | conjunction “if” | *UNNECESSARY* (absorbed in “விரும்பினால்”) | – | UNNECESSARY | | **vuo'** | verb “wish / want” | விரும்பு | “wish / want” | OK | | **campar** | infinitive “to escape” | தப்ப | “escape” | OK | | **d'esto** | demonstrative “this” (genitive) | இந்த | “this” | OK | | **loco** | noun “place” | இடம் | “place” | OK | | **selvaggio** | adjective “savage / wild” | காட்டு | “wild / savage” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *A*, *che*, *se* – Italian functional words that have no independent lexical counterpart in Tamil; their meaning is encoded in the case‑marking or verb morphology. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** errors were detected; all required meanings are present and grammatically correct in the Tamil rendering.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1: - Original: உனக்கு மற்றொரு பயணத்தை எடுத்துக் கொள்ள வேண்டும், - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 2: - Original: அவர் பதிலளித்தார் அவர் என்னை அழுததை கண்டபோது, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 3: - Original: நீ இந்த காட்டு இடத்திலிருந்து தப்ப விரும்பினால்; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
``` உனக்கு மற்றொரு பயணத்தை எடுத்துக் கொள்ள வேண்டும், அவர் பதிலளித்தார் அவர் என்னை அழுததை கண்டபோது, நீ இந்த காட்டு இடத்திலிருந்து தப்ப விரும்பினால்; ```
